channel.title: UNAM Guitar Prep — 3-Week Listening Course
channel.description: Private, curated listening feed for the three-week UNAM classical-guitar preparation program. Playable items are drawn from public broadcaster/direct podcast media. External-only supplements are preserved as custom study:supplement links in the XML.
channel.itunes:author: UNAM Guitar Prep — private study feed
channel.itunes:summary: Three-week Spanish listening-comprehension sequence for 20th- and 21st-century classical guitar history, repertoire, pedagogy, and performance.
